BiblicalUsage: The way, in Aramaic, is the course of a life. Nebuchadnezzar confessed that all God's works are truth and His ways judgment, and that those who walk in pride He is able to abase, while Daniel told Belshazzar that the God in whose hand his breath is, whose are all his ways, he had not glorified.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nebuchadnezzar learned what I need to learn: all God's ways are judgment, and the proud are the ones He abases.
